title: The v-taper split
author: Anik  H.
desc: A program to make you feel like an anime character in real life

ex.note:
The Cue: 
"Bring your biceps together."
   * Don't just push up. Imagine you are trying to touch your biceps to your chin at the top

Setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are in line with your mid-chest (nipple line).

The Cue: "Punch through the ceiling."
Action: Control the way back (negative). Don't let the weight stack slam.

Setup: Set cables at shoulder height.

 * The Cue: "Hug a giant tree."
Keep a slight bend in your elbows. Do NOT press it. Swoop your arms around.

Focus: Squeeze your chest hard for 1 sec

Setup: Stand tall, slight lean forward.
 * The Cue: "Pour the water."Imagine you are holding jugs of water and trying to pour them out at the top.Lead with your ELBOWS.

The Cue: "Break the rope."
At the bottom of the movement, pull your hands apart aggressively.
Strict Rule: Glue your elbows to your ribs.If your elbows move forward and backyou are cheating.

The Cue: "Elbows into pockets."
   * Don't pull the bar down with your hands.
Drive your elbows down towards your back pockets.
Range: Pull to the top of your chest. Do not pull to your belly.

The Cue: "Puff your chest out."
As you pull the handle back, stick your
chest out to meet it.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together like you are trying to crack a walnut between them.

The Cue: "Start the lawnmower."
Pull the dumbbell towards your hip, not your chest.This targets the lower lat.

Setup: Rope set to eye level.
The Cue: "Double Bicep Pose."
Pull the rope towards your forehead while rotating your hands back.
You should end up in a "flexing" position.This protects your shoulders
Focus: Squeeze the forearm and bicep at the top. Lower slowly.

Stance: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly out.
The Cue: "Sit between your legs."
   * Break at the hipsand knees at the same time.Depth: Go until your thighs are parallel to the floor.

Safety: NEVER lock your knees at the top. Keep a tiny bend.
Focus: Push through your heels, not your toes.

The Cue: "Kick a football."
Action: Hold the legs straight at the top for 1.full second. It will burn.That is the point.

The Cue: "Bicep by the ear."
At the top of the press, your biceps should be next to your ears.
Core: Flex your abs hard so your lower back doesn't arch.

Grip: Palms facing you.
 * The Cue: "Chest to bar."
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself all the way down to a dead hang. No half reps.

Setup: Bench at 45-60 degrees. Sit back.
Focus: Let your arms hang completely straight at the bottom. The stretch is where the growth happens.

Grip: Cup the dumbbell head with both hands.
The Cue: "Deep stretch."
Lower the weight behind your head until you feel a painful stretch in your triceps. Then fire up.

Setup: Hold bar/DBs at thighs. Slight bend in knees.
 * The Cue: "Close the car door with your butt."
Push your hips BACK. The weight simply slides down your legs.

The Cue: "Show your butt to the wall."
   * Don't just lift your legs. Curl your pelvis upso your butt points forward. That engages the lower abs.
